references.text: The same principle of adding a fifth part when redeeming applies also to unclean animals that are redeemed
A corresponding rule about adding a fifth part applies when someone wishes to redeem their house that has been dedicated to the Lord
The rule about the fifth part also applies when redeeming consecrated land
The principle of adding a fifth part as compensation for holy things is also found in the laws concerning the guilt offering
A corresponding law about adding a fifth part applies in cases of unintentionally eating holy offerings
The tithe was given to the Levites as their inheritance for serving in the tent of meeting
Regulations regarding the tithe of the harvest that must be brought to the place the Lord chooses
